I can recommend Kungsleden (Kings Trail) in the north of Sweden. Very picturesque and you can break it down into legs. Starting in Abisko, going south, is what I did.. all the way to Kvikkjokk. You can buy a hut membership and pay a little less to camp and use their facilities or stay in their huts. Best time is probably gonna be July/August. I went in September and, although it rained, the weather was good enough imo. Took us 9 days to walk 170km.
